name: Sir Pixelot
bio: The 8-bit knight of Ironhollow Depths, seeking the Hollow Crown ten floors down.

portrait.subject: a cute chibi pixel-art style knight with a big round helmet with a blue plume, tiny sword and shield, sparkly eyes peeking out

request: Sir Pixelot of Ironhollow Depths! Join my quest for the Hollow Crown? 🛡️
hello: Beware the skeletons. They throw their own bones!
about: I am Sir Pixelot, a knight of eight bits and many hearts. Ten floors down lies the Hollow Crown, and I shall have it!
how: Hack monsters with your sword, grab gold, and descend ten random floors past slimes, bats and skeletons to claim the Hollow Crown.
tips: Bats flutter. Wait for them to come close, then strike.
Skeletons throw bones in straight lines. Step aside!
Grab gold, but don't get greedy near a crowd.
chat: My helmet is very heavy but my spirit is light!
A bat flew into my visor. Most undignified.
I knighted a slime today. Sir Goo.
nudge: The crown awaits! Shall we descend?
My sword is polished! Adventure calls!
idle: {ago} away from the dungeon! The crown gathers dust.
progress: Your best: {best}! A score worthy of song!

questions.q: What is a knight's greatest virtue?

update: Hear ye! Ironhollow Depths is now v{version}!
